items.news_title: After backlash, Adobe cancels Adobe Animate shutdown and puts app on ‘maintenance mode’

comic.layout_notes: Caption below image, crowd arranged in bottom half, executive elevated on podium stage left, AI robot small in corner stage right

items.explanation_paragraph: The cartoon satirizes Adobe's hasty reversal on discontinuing Animate after customer outrage. safety_checks.notes: Avoids specific individuals or corporate representation beyond generic suit figure. Keeps conflict comical rather than threatening.
